cohort: 200 patients undergoing cesarean section with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia at the Department of Obstetrics at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University hospital.
finding: A 0.6 ug/kg loading dose of dexmedetomidine administered intravenously within 10 min before cesarean section effectively achieved satisfactory sedative effects, maintained intraoperative hemodynamic stability, resulted in fewer adverse reactions, and increased anterograde amnesia compared to saline.
